motivation: The one-pass full-GC S-only fit failed M5 known-side on later data and on an exploratory same-row TRAIN replay; test basic real-data fit capacity before any larger model round.
one_question: Can the identical fresh model and 25-cell S loss learn certified M5 minute5 side on a fixed small earlier TRAIN subset after repeated exposure?

fixed_data.selection: 64 evenly spread contiguous B16 windows from the exact 47338-row Fold2 mature TRAIN axis, using numpy linspace(0, 47338-16, num=64, dtype=int64) as the start index for each window
fixed_data.feature_and_target_bindings: reuse exact full-fit 003 input owners, feature fit cutoff, S target upper clock and 25 preselected query cells

training.epoch_order: same fixed chronological 64 B16 windows each epoch, no reshuffle
training.initialization: same fresh deterministic full-GC S-only model and empty AdamW as full-fit 003; never import its final checkpoint
training.loss: same equal certified-row 25-cell activity plus conditional-side loss; no architecture, feature, label, head or weight change

measurement.primary: M5 minute5 known-side Brier and AUC on the same 366 certified sides, plus mean predicted UP versus actual UP
measurement.secondary: All 25 activity and side cells, full masks and optimizer/gradient records; same-row M5 versus D1 and minute1 versus minute5 output discrimination on the fixed TRAIN subset.
measurement.predeclared_fit_screen: M5 minute5 side Brier below both fresh initial and same-row fixed +1 prior, and AUC above fresh initial. Any gain is only memorization capacity, not generalization or Edge.

decision_after_result: If the tiny real TRAIN slice still cannot improve side, investigate shared-head/gradient conflict and target-to-feature mapping before any broader fit. If it can, use a separately frozen later/forward design to test generalization; never treat this TRAIN result as Edge.
